players.product: Power Innovation behind-the-meter gas power plants for data centers (Socrates, Aquila, Apollo) and Transco natural gas pipeline expansions serving data-center power demand

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: Transmission, Power & Gulf segment revenues were $5,443 million in 2025 (2024: $4,628 million) and segment Modified EBITDA was $3,720 million ($3,273 million); additions to long-lived segment assets were $3,845 million. Transco's system had a design capacity of approximately 20.6 MMdth/d at December 31, 2025; during 2025 Transco placed in service the Commonwealth Energy Connector (0.1 MMdth/d of firm transportation capacity), Alabama Georgia Connector (0.1), Texas to Louisiana Energy Pathway (0.4) and Southeast Energy Connector (0.2) expansion projects.

10-K customer concentration: the top ten customers of the interstate natural gas pipelines accounted for approximately 44 percent of regulated interstate natural gas transportation and storage revenues in 2025; NWP's three largest customers accounted for approximately 52 percent of NWP's operating revenues.
